extraMeanings.en: (grammar) to limit or describe the meaning of another word
extraMeanings.exampleEn: In "a red car", the adjective "red" modifies the noun "car".

extraMeanings.en: to watch and check something over a period of time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Doctors carefully monitor the patient's heart rate.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar hastanın kalp atışını dikkatle izliyor.

extraMeanings.en: extremely large
extraMeanings.exampleEn: They served us a monster portion of fries.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Bize kocaman bir porsiyon patates kızartması getirdiler.

extraMeanings.en: a larger amount or number
extraMeanings.exampleEn: We need more chairs for the guests.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Misafirler için daha fazla sandalyeye ihtiyacımız var.

extraMeanings.en: to get up onto a horse, bicycle, or platform
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She mounted her horse and rode away.

extraMeanings.en: to gradually increase in amount or intensity
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Tension was mounting as the deadline approached.

extraMeanings.en: to fasten something with nails
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He nailed the boards to the wall.

extraMeanings.en: to become or make less wide
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The road narrows just after the bridge.

extraMeanings.en: only just successful or avoided by a small amount
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The team had a narrow escape from defeat.

extraMeanings.en: to sleep for a short time, especially during the day
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The baby is napping in the next room.

extraMeanings.en: to come close to in space or time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: As we neared the city, traffic increased.

extraMeanings.en: almost, nearly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The project is near complete.

extraMeanings.en: to move your head up and down to show agreement or greeting
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She nodded to show she understood.

extraMeanings.en: based on facts rather than personal feelings
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A good journalist should try to be objective.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: İyi bir gazeteci nesnel olmaya çalışmalıdır.

extraMeanings.en: to obey a law, rule, or custom
extraMeanings.exampleEn: All drivers must observe the speed limit.

extraMeanings.en: to make a remark or comment
extraMeanings.exampleEn: "It's getting late," she observed.

extraMeanings.en: to live or stay in a place
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The family has occupied this house for years.

extraMeanings.en: to come into someone's mind, especially suddenly
extraMeanings.exampleEn: It never occurred to me that she might be lying.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yalan söylüyor olabileceği hiç aklıma gelmedi.

extraMeanings.en: connected with attacking; an attack
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The army launched a major offensive at dawn.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Ordu şafakta büyük bir saldırı başlattı.

extraMeanings.en: a job or position that is available
extraMeanings.exampleEn: There is an opening for a manager at the company.

extraMeanings.en: first, beginning part of something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The opening scene of the film is very dramatic.

extraMeanings.en: the way something works or functions
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new law comes into operation next month.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni yasa gelecek ay yürürlüğe giriyor.

extraMeanings.en: the right to buy or sell something at a fixed price within a set time
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He bought stock options as part of his contract.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmesinin bir parçası olarak hisse opsiyonları aldı.

extraMeanings.en: to travel around something in a curved path
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The satellite orbits the Earth every 90 minutes.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Uydu Dünya'nın yörüngesinde her 90 dakikada bir döner.

extraMeanings.en: a large musical instrument with keys and pipes
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She played the organ at the church every Sunday.
